Cyclone Arnab causes deaths, damage across India

Cyclone Arnab has caused deaths and significant damage across several Indian states. In Andhra Pradesh, Chief Minister Naidu estimated losses at Rs 4600 crore and reported seven fatalities. Odisha experienced landslides and floods, resulting in three deaths, with rescue operations nearing completion. A house collapsed into floodwaters in Ganjam. In Bihar, a red alert was issued for two districts due to heavy rain. Gangtok recorded a significant temperature drop of 11.4°C due to the cyclone's effects.
